claims.statement: The sidebar is resizable from the keyboard, which is what separated this asset from its placeholder.
All behavior comes from Resizable; this asset contributes defaults and a landmark, nothing else.
Sidebar and content both reflow at the declared minimum without horizontal document overflow.

component.purpose: A sidebar-shaped preset over the shared resize primitive, not a second shell.
component.title: ResizableSidebar

states.description: Preset sidebar with pointer and keyboard resizing.
Content stays usable at the declared minimum.
